SIDING WIZARD

Load the cart by matching each siding definition to its correct term. Questions allow 15–20 seconds depending on length and obscurity. A wrong answer or timeout costs 20–30 points. Answer within the first 10 seconds for a +10 bonus, capped at 100%.

Capitalization, punctuation, spaces, and hyphens are ignored. If the Siding Wizard meter reaches 0%, the run ends immediately.
